resources.string: Unplug uses Accessibility Service solely to detect vertical scroll gestures inside YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels to calculate your doomscroll dose and protect your brain. 100% on-device processing. Zero data collection, no personal messages or screen content are ever read.

To help you break doomscrolling addiction, Unplug needs the Accessibility Service permission.

• Why it is needed: Detects when you scroll to the next video inside YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels to count your daily dose.

• Privacy & Security: Unplug operates 100% locally on your device. We NEVER read messages, passwords, keystrokes, personal details, or video content.

• Zero Data Collection: No data is ever saved or transmitted to any server.
